functions.name: vault_directory
functions.title: Read Vault Account Directory
functions.description: Read the signed-in admin's saved account references, never credentials or access keys. Supports pages of 50 records; pass the returned next_offset to read another page. Connection type indicates a slot or reference, not verified live status.

offset.description: Starting offset from 0 to 10000; defaults to 0.

functions.name: apex_discovery
functions.title: Read APEX Capability Discovery
functions.description: Run the existing admin-only read probes for connected Strategic Minds provider capabilities. Returns evidence-backed connectivity observations only; it does not authorize writes or production actions.

functions.name: infrastructure_inventory
functions.title: Read Infrastructure Inventory
functions.description: Read the existing admin account overview for one connected infrastructure provider. Supported providers are GitHub, Vercel, Supabase, and Railway.

functions.name: benchmark_read
functions.title: Read Benchmark Control Plane
functions.description: Read the existing benchmark catalog, roadmap, checkpoint, job list, or benchmark metadata from the admin portal without changing the frontend or claiming release certification.

functions.name: benchmark_validator
functions.title: Run Benchmark Validator
functions.description: Invoke the existing independent benchmark validator. Self-check and plan review are non-destructive. A run records signed benchmark evidence but never accepts caller-supplied scores or evidence.

functions.name: benchmark_coding_control
functions.title: Control Benchmark Coding Agent
functions.description: Control the existing benchmark coding-agent automation. Status is read-only. Install, enable, pause, and run require the existing function's explicit approved=true gate. Live-release authorization is intentionally not exposed through MCP.
